_comment: Reference for the ElevenLabs dashboard's webhook tool builder. This tool calls the Slack Incoming Webhook URL directly — no Azure Function in between, per the brief's 'simple to wire' framing for the escalation path.
name: escalate_to_supervisor
description: Flag a supervisor in Slack when the technician says an issue isn't resolved, or directly asks for help/a supervisor.

text.description: One line summary Slack will display, e.g. '🚨 FieldWise escalation — machine 12: alarm 402 not resolved after servo-overload troubleshooting.' Include the machine ID if the technician gave one and a short issue summary.

response_notes: Slack incoming webhooks reply with the plain text 'ok' on success (HTTP 200), not JSON — the agent just needs to know the call succeeded to confirm out loud.
